{{Conjecture|legends}}
At some point by [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]],<ref name="Date">[[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']], which includes an [[in-universe]] [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] posting on [[Faarl]], is dated to three [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. Since ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates that conflict to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the placement of the sourcebook therefore translates to [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]]. Since {{InsiderCite|80|The History of the Mandalorians: Exploring the Evolution of a Mighty Race of Warriors}} states the bounty was eventually collected by [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], [[Gender/Legends|he]] must have claimed it at some point by that date.</ref> the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] carried out<ref name="Insider80">{{InsiderCite|80|The History of the Mandalorians: Exploring the Evolution of a Mighty Race of Warriors}}</ref> an '''assault''' on [[Fortress Baarlos]]<ref name="CSWE Fortress">{{CSWECite|I|291|Fortress Baarlos}}</ref> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Pochi]].<ref name="WbC">[[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']]</ref>
